dedupe_keys.name: great britain hourly natural gas demand at distribution level january 2017 to march 2018

description: This data set is an hourly record of natural gas demand on Great Britain's local distribution networks from January 2017 to March 2018. It was created by I. A. G. Wilson for the UK Energy Research Centre's Phase 3 FlexiNET project, to compare the size and shape of local gas demand with electricity supply, and a UKERC briefing note uses part of it. It aggregates the hourly operational demand data of Great Britain's four gas distribution network companies, so it is an empirical record, not model output. Columns give the hour in UTC, a time-zone-aware UTC timestamp, a check of the step between rows, London local time in aware and text forms, the local time step, and cleaned national distribution-level demand in kilowatt hours. Coverage is Great Britain's distribution networks, aggregated nationally. The file is a single CSV of about 1.6 MB, downloadable from Zenodo (version 1.0.0) under CC BY 4.0 at no cost. Caveats: only 15 months are covered, including one winter, and demand is aggregated to Great Britain, not per network. Simulation uses are comparing gas and electricity peak loads, heat electrification studies and cold-weather demand planning. Related records: none linked on the provider's pages read on the day.
